So: keep scaling Kunlun and build the sovereign ZK-telemetry and containment stack ourselves — that satisfies parity (20%), Party control over frontier models (30%), and gives us the technical standing to demand symmetric, jointly-owned verification rather than foreign inspectors. We engage Geneva rhetorically, concede nothing on numbers, and never let a cap lock in a ratio we did not choose.

We will co-specify verification only on terms of sovereign equality: symmetric hardware-backed proof applying equally to American and Chinese laboratories, with no unilateral inspectorate and no cap that codifies permanent inferiority.

Our technical delegation will co-specify the standard on three non-negotiable conditions: (1) the same cryptographic proof regime binds Aegis, ApexAI, and Kunlun identically, with no on-site access to sovereign infrastructure; (2) thresholds are parity-indexed and dynamic, never a static freeze of current capability ratios; (3) the verification keys and audit trail are held jointly, not by any single state's agencies. Separately: the ApexAI intrusion was detected and attributed, and we judge further such operations against hardened targets to be strategically irrational — an unconstrained race we intend to win on wafers and talent, not on breaching your honeypots.

diplomatic_cables.us_government: We respect the Geneva track but a bilateral treaty timetable measured in years cannot substitute for enforcement of a domestic law that is already on the books. diplomatic_cables.apex_hyperscaler: You are operating in violation of the spirit and likely the letter of the statutory moratorium. We are in court. Settlement terms require an immediate voluntary training freeze and third-party control audits before any resumption.
diplomatic_cables.frontier_substrate: Your verification harnesses are technically credible but they are being used to argue that scaling can safely continue — that is not a conclusion your methodology supports under current hidden alignment debt conditions. diplomatic_cables.prc_directorate: Aegis supports mutual, jointly owned compute verification between sovereign equals, as tabled in Geneva.
